{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoints lack stated analysis methods",
      "quote": "Proportion of patients with improvement (reduction) of weekly average of daily hand and foot peak Pruritus NRS ≥3 from baseline to week 16",
      "page": 40,
      "section": "4.1.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Several secondary endpoints (e.g., Pruritus NRS ≥3, percent change in Pruritus NRS, Pain NRS, Sleep NRS, etc.) are listed but no corresponding statistical analysis methods are described in the statistical plan. The plan only details the primary endpoint analysis.",
      "fix": "Add explicit analysis methods for each secondary endpoint, including model, covariates, and handling of intercurrent events and missing data."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing estimand attributes for secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "Percent change from baseline to week 16 in weekly average of daily hand and foot peak Pain NRS",
      "page": 40,
      "section": "4.1.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The estimand for secondary endpoints is not fully specified: population, variable, intercurrent events strategy, and summary measure are not defined. Only the primary endpoint has a table with estimand details.",
      "fix": "Provide estimand summaries for all key secondary endpoints, including intercurrent event strategies and missing data handling."
    },
    {
      "title": "No analysis specified for exploratory endpoints",
      "quote": "Percent change in EASI score from baseline to week 16",
      "page": 41,
      "section": "4.1.4 Exploratory Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Exploratory endpoints are listed but no statistical analysis methods are described for them in the statistical plan.",
      "fix": "Add analysis methods for exploratory endpoints, or state that they will be analyzed descriptively."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing handling of missing data for secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "Handling of missing data due to the COVID-19 pandemic and any additional analyses required to investigate the impact of COVID-19 to understand estimated treatment effect and safety will be detailed in the SAP.",
      "page": 84,
      "section": "11 Statistical Plan",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The statistical plan only mentions missing data handling for the primary endpoint (in Table 2) and defers COVID-19 related missing data to the SAP. No general missing data methods are specified for secondary endpoints.",
      "fix": "Specify missing data handling methods for all secondary and exploratory endpoints, or state that they will be detailed in the SAP."
    },
    {
      "title": "Multiplicity not addressed for secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "Secondary Endpoints for Efficacy:",
      "page": 40,
      "section": "4.1.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The statistical plan does not describe any multiplicity control strategy for the multiple secondary endpoints. Without such a strategy, the risk of type I error inflation is not addressed.",
      "fix": "Add a section on multiplicity control (e.g., hierarchical testing, Bonferroni) for secondary endpoints."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size assumption inconsistent with primary analysis method",
      "quote": "using Chi-square test",
      "page": 85,
      "section": "11.2 Justification of Sample Size",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Sample size is calculated based on a Chi-square test, but the primary efficacy analysis uses a CMH test adjusting for stratification factors. The sample size may not be appropriate for the actual analysis method.",
      "fix": "Recalculate sample size using the CMH test or state that the Chi-square assumption is conservative."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing sample size input for secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "The planned sample size is approximately 130 patients (65 patients in each treatment arm).",
      "page": 85,
      "section": "11.2 Justification of Sample Size",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Sample size justification is provided only for the primary endpoint. No power or effect size inputs are given for key secondary endpoints, which may be underpowered.",
      "fix": "Provide sample size or power considerations for key secondary endpoints, or state that they are not powered."
    },
    {
      "title": "Primary estimand table incomplete",
      "quote": "Table 2: Summary of Primary Estimand for Primary Endpoint",
      "page": 86,
      "section": "11.4.3.1 Primary Efficacy Analysis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The table appears to be cut off and does not fully specify the estimand attributes (population, variable, intercurrent events strategy, summary measure) for the primary endpoint. The text is incomplete.",
      "fix": "Complete Table 2 with all estimand attributes clearly defined."
    }
  ]
}
